summary_markdown: A discussion arose regarding a potential data anomaly observed in the bottom table of a mall analytics dashboard, specifically comparing totals to unique users. The issue was identified as potentially related to real-time data inclusion if the current date is included in the period. A specific user/client (UK JCDecaux) and an email address ([email@jcdecaux.com]) were mentioned in relation to this review. Later, the live analytics feed appeared, prompting a fix for strange zone data within the query.
decisions: The discrepancy in the mall analytics dashboard was attributed to real-time date inclusion.
action_items: Fixing strange zone data in the live analytics query.
